properties.name: Masinga reservoir max extent (validation)
properties.description: Copernicus GLO-30 pixels at or below the mask level, connected to the reservoir seed, behind the digitised closure line. Water outside this mask is never counted. The DEM postdates the dam: below its flat lake surface it shows water, not the reservoir bed.
properties.closure_axis_source: Digitised 2026-10-10 (prompt 05a) on a Sentinel-2 L2A median composite, Jun–Sep 2025 (Cloud Score+ ≥ 0.6); not a published value.
